method.acceptanceRule: A roadmap-evidence file counts as an accepted "main-proof" receipt only if its filename contains the literal substring "main-proof". Files named "*-main-verification-*", "*-completion-*", "*-parent-acceptance-*", "*-local-*", "*-review-*", "*-premerge-*", "*-merge-*" do NOT count, even when their content describes an exact-main SHA and passing gates (this repo used a "main-verification"/"completion" naming convention for the 2026-09-12 wave 0 work, before adopting the "main-proof" convention on 2026-09-13 onward; the earlier files are flagged per-row below rather than silently accepted or silently dropped).

verdictLegend.FLIP: The task text is fully discharged by a merged, exact-main "main-proof"-named receipt (or, for a pure documentation/verification task, by a recorded finding inside a PR that itself carries a main-proof receipt); a follow-up PR should simply check the box.
verdictLegend.PARTIAL: A main-proof receipt (or the roadmap node's own admission text) covers part of the task; a named residual remains open. The checkbox should stay unchecked until the residual clears, or the task text should be split.
verdictLegend.OPEN: No merged exact-main receipt exists for this task at all (planned/blocked/unmerged/in-flight-only), or the only "proof" offered is prose in an admission brief rather than a receipt.
verdictLegend.ALREADY-CHECKED-NO-ROADMAP-RECEIPT: The checkbox is already [x] on origin/main today (real, pre-existing fact, verified by reading tasks.md at origin/main), but this roadmap effort supplies no main-proof-named evidence file for it and the owning roadmap node carries no receipt (node state is frequently still "planned" or the claim lives only in an admission-brief driftNote). Not FLIP (nothing to flip -- it is already flipped) and not the same as PARTIAL/OPEN (no admitted gap and no roadmap-generated proof either). Reported separately so the caller does not mistake pre-roadmap history for this roadmap's output, and so a stale ledger/roadmap-node status gets flagged.
